scope: Actual BaseItem.RefreshMetadata/RefreshExtras and LibraryManager.FindExtras/ExtraResolver for sixteen Book/Photo file-owner and PhotoAlbum/Folder directory-owner boundaries. Actual video/audio resolvers, real filesystem and EF SQLite repository/persistence run. Ordinary non-video extensions are compared with deliberately video-shaped owner paths and directory owners. Single-item provider refresh callbacks perform no save, so new extras remain live and are not inserted or Added. Collection membership, provider callbacks, media-source and external-data dispatch are controlled. No BookMetadataService lifecycle, photo tag decoding, image generation, complete scanner or release acceptance.
